- Private deployment timeline: We can offer VPC-hosted Private deployments within 4-6 weeks after contract signature for standard integrations; on-prem air-gapped options are on a project timeline (8-12 weeks). I'll have Camila confirm exact infra pre-reqs for your ML infra team.
- Procurement / Pricing: Attached MAP includes a draft committed capacity pricing row and proposed overage policy (monthly true-up). We'll also share a sample SOW this week.

Thanks — Marissa

Hey all — quick tech note and pilot ask from our side.

Pilot sizing recommendations:
- Pilot scope: 2 production-like endpoints, 1M tokens/day peak (estimated), 1-week sustained load test + 1-week functional validation
- Infra: 2 x GPU instances (NVIDIA H100-equivalent) for pilot serving; NGINX load balancer; small DB for telemetry (we can use managed DB)
- Data: We recommend using synthetic/anonymized PII for the pilot to avoid regulatory delays; if FinPay needs PII in pilot, we'll need a signed DPA and approved network boundary

Technical owners: Rishi and I will support the pilot setup; Rishi will lead the on-call for load testing windows. 

I'll follow up with a short pilot runbook and estimate (hours + cost) by EOD Friday so Mei and Tom can review before procurement kickoff.

Camila
